decisions.reason: As an inertial measurement sensor module it fits the firm's established modular sensing platform, so its strong related knowledge, in-house R&D and ability to refine documentation, firmware and interfaces make continued commercialization worthwhile.

The industrial AC voltage input module directly extends the firm's existing measurement and automation building blocks, and the firm's absorptive capacity in hardware, firmware and modular integration supports learning from early use and improving it.

A four-channel solid state relay module is closely complementary to the firm's control and automation range, so the product benefits from high overlap with existing technical knowledge and customer applications.

The server room monitoring sensor kit builds on the firm's sensor, controller and software ecosystem, and the firm is well positioned to interpret initial demand and iterate the kit using its existing platform capabilities.
